items.name: surfaces
items.title: Surfaces
items.description: Eight-level surface and shadow ladder for elevation. Light: two color steps then flat white, differentiated by shadow. Dark: additive white-opacity ladder with layered inset highlights and drops.

light.shadow-6: 0 0 0 1px var(--shadow-color), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--shadow-color), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--shadow-color), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--shadow-color)
light.shadow-7: 0 0 0 1px var(--shadow-color), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--shadow-color), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--shadow-color), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--shadow-color), 0 48px 48px -24px var(--shadow-color)
light.shadow-8: 0 0 0 1px var(--shadow-color), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--shadow-color), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--shadow-color), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--shadow-color), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--shadow-color), 0 48px 48px -24px var(--shadow-color), 0 96px 96px -48px var(--shadow-color)

dark.shadow-3: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-mid), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-base), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-4: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-mid), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-mid), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-5: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-high), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-mid), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-6: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-high), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-high), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.18), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--dm-drop), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-7: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-peak), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-high), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.20), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--dm-drop), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--dm-drop), 0 48px 48px -24px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-8: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-peak), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-high), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.22), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--dm-drop), 0 24px 24px -12px var(--dm-drop), 0 48px 48px -24px var(--dm-drop), 0 96px 96px -48px var(--dm-drop)

items.name: tokens
items.title: Interaction Tokens
items.description: Shared interaction-state tokens: surface-relative hover/active overlays (bg-hover, bg-active), the selected fill, the destructive-light ground, the --overlay RGB triplet, the --focus-ring color, and the base-layer :focus-visible fallback ring.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: Utility function for merging Tailwind CSS classes with clsx and tailwind-merge.

items.name: springs
items.title: Spring Animations
items.description: Spring animation token presets for Framer Motion (fast, moderate, slow).

items.name: font-weight
items.title: Font Weight Tokens
items.description: Variable font weight tokens for Inter (normal, medium, semibold, bold) using font-variation-settings.

items.name: surface-context
items.title: Surface Context
items.description: React context that tracks the current substrate elevation level. Elevated components (Dropdown, Select, etc.) read it via useSurface() and render at substrate + offset, then re-provide a new substrate so further nesting elevates further.

items.name: surface-classes
items.title: Surface Class Lookup
items.description: Static lookup tables for bg-surface-N and shadow-surface-N utilities. Required because Tailwind v4 cannot detect template-literal class names.

items.name: elevated
items.title: Elevated
items.description: Elevation primitive. Wraps the read-substrate / compute-level / apply-classes / re-provide-context pattern into one component. Pulls in the surface theme tokens, substrate context, and class lookup so a single install drops in the whole elevation system.

items.name: theme-context
items.title: Theme Context
items.description: React context provider for system/light/dark theme switching, with a `T` shortcut, a transition guard for the colour cross-fade, and a `resolvedTheme` that settles "system" against the OS preference.

items.name: shape-context
items.title: Shape Context
items.description: React context provider for runtime shape variant switching (pill or rounded). Controls border-radius across all Delta Components components.

items.name: size-context
items.title: Size Context
items.description: React context provider for the two-step size ladder (36px default, 28px compact). Controls control heights, text, icon, and padding scale across all Delta Components components, and exports the role-based typography scale.

items.name: icon-context
items.title: Icon Context
items.description: Named icon slots with a Lucide default set; swap any icon via IconProvider.

items.name: use-proximity-hover
items.title: useProximityHover
items.description: React hook for proximity-based hover detection. Tracks the closest item to the mouse cursor within a container, enabling smooth animated background indicators.

items.name: use-touch-primary
items.title: useTouchPrimary
items.description: Detects touch-primary devices (coarse pointer + touch points), updating live on pointer-mode and media-query changes. Adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: use-merge-split
items.title: useMergeSplitBlocks
items.description: React hook + renderer for the selected-background merge/split animation. When one row bridges or splits two contiguous selected runs, their inner edges glide together (or apart) and swap to a single block, instead of one block spring-growing over the union.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Animated button with variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, loading spinner, and fluid font-weight transitions on hover.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Dropdown menu with proximity hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem.

items.name: input-copy
items.title: Input Copy
items.description: Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button and animated check feedback. Supports optional label and shape context.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation and fluid font-weight label transitions.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and proximity-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators.

items.name: sidebar-menu-grid
items.title: Sidebar Menu Grid
items.description: Shared popup geometry for sidebar-anchored dropdown menus: trigger width +10px shifted -4px, items on the rows' leading and text axes, trailing glyphs on the trigger chevron's axis.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Base UI flavor; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

.scroll-fade.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), transparent 100%)
.scroll-fade.mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), transparent 100%)

.scroll-fade-x.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), transparent 100%)
.scroll-fade-x.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), transparent 100%)

.scroll-fade.mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-start)) 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-end)) 100%)
.scroll-fade.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-start)) 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-end)) 100%)
.scroll-fade.animation: sf-reveal-start both linear, sf-reveal-end both linear

.scroll-fade-x.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-start)) 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-end)) 100%)
.scroll-fade-x.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-start)) 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-size), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-size)), rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--sf-end)) 100%)
.scroll-fade-x.animation: sf-reveal-start both linear, sf-reveal-end both linear

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, proximity hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Floating tooltip with spring-based animations, configurable placement, and rich content support.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact label with solid and dot variants, Tailwind color palette, and three sizes.

items.name: tabs-subtle
items.title: Tabs Subtle
items.description: Horizontal tab navigation with proximity hover, animated pill selection indicator, and fluid font-weight transitions.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with a filename bar, copy button, optional line numbers, expand/collapse, and a package-manager tab strip that expands an npx command into npm, yarn, pnpm, and bun.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product Card
items.description: Compound card for commerce interfaces: a square image well with an optional overlaid badge, and a title/subtitle/metric footer. Ships default and inner layouts and a three-step size scale.
